classified.description:
During your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Follow Him either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {8}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, creating that many Clue tokens.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.mana_needed: {8}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable at most

classified.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

template.scryfallQuery: mv<=1 (mana={0} or mana={1} or mana={C}) is:permanent

classified.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

components.battlefield_state: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness
components.name: Breath of Fury

classified.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Loyal Apprentice triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
classified.notable_prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
outcomes: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

classified.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Officious Interrogation by paying {W}{U} plus an additional {W}{U} as necessary, creating at least eight Clue artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.mana_needed: {W}{U}, plus an additional {W}{U} per opponent as necessary
classified.notable_prerequisites: The number of creatures on the battlefield is equal to or greater than eight minus the number of Clue tokens you control.

classified.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E}.

classified.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Masterful Replication by paying {5}{U}, causing all artifacts you control to become a copy of the artifact with Mechanized Production attached until end of turn.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, causing you to create a token of the artifact it is attached to and win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control at least eight lands.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control another creature.
outcomes: Infinitely large creature until end of turn

classified.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
outcomes: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control

classified.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

Declare Aurelia as an attacker, triggering it and Shaun's first ability.
Resolve the Shaun trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Aurelia that is a nonlegendary Synth in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
classified.notable_prerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
outcomes: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

components.name: Mechanized Production

classified.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating a number of Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it's attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.easy_prerequisites: Ant-Man's power is at least 8 minus the number of Treasures you control, minus an additional 1 if Mechanized Production is attached to a Treasure.
classified.notable_prerequisites: An opponent cannot block Ant-Man.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Kill an artifact creature you control.
Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
The Clue enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You have a way to kill an artifact creature you control.

classified.description:
Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, attaching it to the creature that has Mechanized Production attached.
Each other nontoken creature you control becomes a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Mechanized Production attached to an artifact creature you control.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat.

Declare the legendary creature with haste and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Shaun's first ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token of the legendary creature with haste that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the token copy of the legendary creature with haste, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
outcomes: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

classified.description:
Activate Olivia's Attendants by paying {2}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Deal combat damage with Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants trggers, creating six Blood tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Olivia's Attendants.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Synth Infiltrator. Choose to have Synth Infiltrator enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.easy_prerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator.

classified.description:
Declare Raphael as an attacker. Shaun triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Raphael that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the Raphael token. It triggers, untapping all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
classified.notable_prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control

classified.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Synth Infiltrator. Choose to have Synth Infiltrator enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.easy_prerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator.

classified.description: Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Synth Infiltrator into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.

classified.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U} while keeping at least seven Treasures on the battlefield, attaching it to a Treasure you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments; additional permanents beyond this minimum can reduce the mana needed.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and three tapped Food tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control at least three Foods.

classified.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.
classified.easy_prerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.

classified.description:
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering Obeka, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this phase.
Move to your next upkeep step. At the beginning of that step, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token copy of the artifact it's attached to, and win the game if you control eight or more artifacts that share a name.
Repeat step 2 as necessary for the remaining upkeep steps until you win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Obeka's power is greater than or equal to 8 minus the number of artifacts you control that share a name with the artifact that has Mechanized Production attached.
An opponent cannot block Obeka.

classified.description:
On the end step before your turn, activate all lands you control by tapping them, creating that many Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control at least eight in any combination of lands and/or Treasure tokens.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

components.name: Mechanized Production

classified.description:
Cast Mutagen Man by paying {8}{G}{G} minus {1} for each Mutagen you control.
When Mutagen Man enters, it triggers, creating a number of Mutagen tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it's attached to and causing you to win the game.
classified.mana_needed: {8}{G}{G} minus {1} for each Mutagen you control
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Old Gnawbone.
Old Gnawbone triggers, creating seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U}, attaching it to a Treasure token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Old Gnawbone does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Old Gnawbone.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying {3}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum the Hegemon.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum the Hegemon.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.

Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator
